Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Sulfur-embedded mesoporous hollow carbon spheres guide uniform Na deposition and form NaF-rich interphase via Na2S nanocrystals, stabilizing the interface. Using only 5 wt% sulfur-carbon, the composite anode enables 40 mA cm−2 and 40 mAh cm−2 cycling. Ah-level pouch cells achieve 178 Wh kg−1 and 420 W kg−1, demonstrating a practical route to high-power sodium-metal batteries.

💡 This review uniquely maps MXene–TMD heterostructure design from atomic descriptors to cell-level battery performance across seven metal-ion chemistries.
